name: wai-monorepo
description: wAI - Umgebungs-Gedächtnisanker / Environmental Memory Anchor. Offline-first Android app + bilingual landing page + legal & growth kit.
author: AndrexTheDev <hippie.highho@gmail.com>

scripts.build:android: npm run cap:sync -w @wai/app && cd packages/app/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run check:android
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/app && tsc --noEmit -p packages/landing
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:render -w @wai/app && npm run smoke:render -w @wai/landing
